confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Dutch prices, not from live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer prices are moderately certain. Summer accommodation prices in Delft are the least certain because of peak tourism and university-season demand. Euro figures were converted at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.16. The FX value comes from search-result summaries attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on mid-sized Dutch university and heritage cities near Rotterdam and The Hague, such as Leiden, Haarlem and Utrecht, adjusted for Delft's high summer tourist demand for accommodation.
